history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG - generic CSV name: several Hanuman temples exist in Moga and no single canonical 'Hanuman Mandir' could be established. The best-supported referent is Hanuman Mandir at Bagiana Basti, Moga 142001 - documented by akhandapp.in (rated 5.0 by 20 reviewers, phone +91 98883 09474) with a matching place pin (30.81271, 75.155873) carrying the same phone number. Alternatives that must NOT be conflated: (a) Sri Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple, Sardar Nagar, Moga (onefivenine.com); (b) Prachin Sri Sidh Balaji Hanuman Mandir, Old Grain Market Road, New Town, Moga; (c) Hanuman Temple, Partap Road, New Town, Moga; (d) 'Hanuman mandir' at Mini, Moga marked permanently closed; (e) Hanuman Temple listings in Guru Arjun Dev Nagar. No founding history, festivals or hours are published for the Bagiana Basti shrine. CSV town (Moga) and state are correct. No reliable temple-specific photograph was found after genuine searching, so media is empty.

name: Hanuman Mandir
town_description: Moga is a city and district headquarters in central Punjab, on NH 5 between Ludhiana and Firozpur. The documented referent stands at Bagiana Basti, Moga 142001.

travel.airport: Nearest airports are at Ludhiana (verify distance) and Mohali (about 159 km) / Chandigarh (about 169 km) (verify).
travel.railway: Moga railway station (Northern Railway), connected with Firozpur, Ludhiana, Chandigarh, Ambala, Delhi and Jaipur.
travel.road: Bagiana Basti, Moga 142001; local auto/taxi from Moga bus stand and railway station.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant Punjab weather (verify). Tuesdays and Saturdays are the traditional busy days for Hanuman worship.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not published for this temple (verify). Confirm locally before visiting.
